book.name: Loum
book.title: Loum Poloye Loum sosee mapoo to hogugu tenee

content: Isalael odoo ee Godeeye pegele
Esiga goo ayo hagee takoo ee, Godeeye Isalael odoo gowoolone tei peegoo poogoosomo? Haye, pegele. Bei, anosee Isalael odoo. Osoloso anosee Eibalahameeyo amawe, Benyamineeyo bala ma kulodu badeli.
Osoloso Godeeye daga hesia odoo ee gowoolone peegoo pegele. Egeesi ma kulodu Godeeyo to booka mapoo hogugu oso Ilayaye taka ee medee goolee. Bei, Isalael odoo ee gowoolone Godee mapoo egeesee takaso,

“Wiligi odoo Godee, Isalael odoo hagee biaso to namaga toloso kokodo takomo silesibili odoo ee piliguloso, see namapoo emegei di bi tenelame sili dousulu susuga sabolo guobuguso. Osoloso namaga to toloso kokodo takomo sili odoo hedebe ano badoso. Esino diayo anosee wooloomalame ka seeso,” dee takaso.

Esino Godeeye Ilayayo to su mapoo kasee takasomo? Yayo Ilaya mapoo egeesee takaso, “Amapoo tei teli odoo hedebe nayo koo badoso. Bei, mo odoo 7,000 doso, diba gamenee godee Bal deli eyo hu dokodoo koo poudili,” diso.
Esiga epedee hamapoo osee moloso, Isalael odoo haga susuga oso Godee maga peegoo kukulo dile. Esino Isalael odoo abo yayo sooloo dolone pidi maga yimapoo tei talame diba olo hesiaso.

Esiga Godeeye sooloo dolone pidili maga o odoo hesieliso. Egeesi ma kulodu diayo goo tekepo tolone doga koo seli. Bei, Godeeye odoo hesieli goo ee wulo edebeeyo goo tekepo tolone doga ka hesieli diepi, nei yayo sooloo dolone pidili goo ee goo mauwe meliyo.

Esiga Isalael odoo oso dieso nediliyo Godeeyo howo woola tekepo dabalame diya kitulugiliso. Esino diba goo hagee tele. Esino hedebe Godeeye hesia ono yayo o howo woola olo odoo tekepo diso. Esino odoo aboso Godeeyo to dulei gowoolone mesile poogooso.
Bei, Godeeyo to booka mapoo hogugu oso Isalael odoo dia goo maga egeesee takaso,

content.text: “Godeeye dimapoo goo tiadili goo teneeso,
diayo gooleedele pagalame.
Osoloso Godeeye dia howo gagaso,
diayo egele pagalame.
Osoloso yayo dibada dulu tabagaso,
diayo see dule pagalame.
Esiga goo hageesi oso osee molone epedee hamapoo osee ka moloso.”

content: Egeesi ma kulodu Deibidiye dia goo maga egeesee takaso,

content.text: “Wo toowa nalame mooloogoodoloso egee do goo oso
dieso nediliyo bagagalame ti gama masi meleye dee.
Osoloso diayo omapoo ti gama oso bagagisaloso misige duboloso dobolone,
dibada goo tokenee eyo nei tolone debeeye dee.
Osoloso diayo egele pagalame,
dia howo neliga peye dee.
Osoloso diayo gauwuloso kookaiyo osee silesibilame,
dimapoo hegi goo kadadiye dee.”

content: Yu odoonee oso gie badeli talai

Esiga ayo see tobu hageesee ka takooso, Isalael odooso Keliso gowe goo maga diba olo tokenee pasomo? Haye, egeesee sele. Esino dia goo tokenee maga Yu odoonee dia gie badeli pidiliso, Yu odooso goo egee ogoloso see Yu odoonee mapoo koolone doga, see diayo Yesu mapoo tei ka talame.
Esiga Yu odooso eli dooboo dagadi goo maga Yu odoonee pidiso. Esino Yu odooso dieso eli dooboo dagadi maga see Godee mapoo siboga, biame omapoo nei Yu odoonee dia gie badeli diya pidileiso.
Esiga ayo see tobu epedee hamapoo Yu odoonee nimapoo taka, Yu odoonee niba halo diye di odoo ee aso. Esiga tou Godeeye amapoo tenee hagee ayo goomoga sabolo ka tomo siloso.
Esiga a gooleedele, ayo Yu odoonee halo tou too ee ogoloso, tei mo odoo Yu odooso koolone Godee mapoo sibadalai malaiso. Egeeseega, yayo dia gie badeli pidileiso.

Esiga niba olo gooleedooso, Godeeye Yu odoo dimapoo miligi piaso. Goo egeesi maga Godeeye Yu odoonee ee see o odoo doloso dabalame yimapoo gilimado simiso. Esiga hamamee Godeeye Yu odoo ee yimapoo gilimado siboga, diayo kookaiyo gie badeli talaiso. Goo egee odoo wediaso see gie badeli too egeesi masi moloso.

Esiga niba ege, niyo wo wogai mapoo soo ee pepooko podoloso Godeeyo dalame peegoo magooga, wo wogai mapoo soo toowa onosee Godeeyo dalaiso. Osoloso homo onosee egeesi moloso, homo too ee Godeeyo dalame yimapoo teneega, o dee onosee Godeeyo dalaiso.
Olipi homo maga wudu taka

Esiga Yu odoo ee olipi homo dadabayo segei dee egeesi masi doso. Osoloso Yu odoonee ee olipi homo dobudu meli dee egeesi masi doso. Esino olipi homo dadabayo segei dee abo Godeeye kookoobuguloso, see dobudu meli olipi homo eyo dee koodo sibileso ogusaso. Esiga Yu odoonee niba egeesi masi badoso. Godeeye niba homo dadabayo segei mapoo olo ogusugaso. Esiga olipi homo dadabayo segei oso nimapoo gie ka tenemoloso.

Esino olipi homo dadabayo segei masi dee peegoo kookoobugume, see Yu odoonee niyo o debi mapoo ogusugaloso egee molo goo omaga, niso nediliyo si haga na howee. Bei, niyo homo too mapoo gie badeli koo teneli. Esino tooso dee nimapoo gie badeli ka teneli.
Esiga niyo hageesee takalai malaiso, “Iyo o debi talame homo dee egee olo peegoo kookoobuguso.”

Egeesi ma kulodu niyo tei takoo. Bei, Yu odooso tei telega poogoloso doboome ogoloso homo dee masi peegoo kookoobuguso. Eseme niyo tei too maga homo dee kobugu su omapoo olo ogusugaso. Esiga niba goo omapoo niso nediliyo si haga na howee. Esino niba ebia sabolo debee.
Bei, Godeeye homo tei o deedee peegoo kookoobugu egeesi masi solone niyo tei telega doga, niba nosee peegoo egeesee kookoobigileiso.

Esiga niba medee goolee, Godee diya mesie, osoloso Godee yo goo tokenee mapoo diya goweli. Esiga yayo Yu odoo abo yimaga peegoo diyadee eyo nei dimapoo dala teneliso. Esino niyo yayo mesili goo mapoo tei toloso osee doga, Godeeye nei nimapoo mesileiso. Esino niyo yimapoo tei telega doga, Godeeye niba homo dee masi peegoo kobigileiso.
Egeesi ma kulodu Yu odooso see Godee mapoo tei toga, Godeeye diba see tobu homo dee masi todileso, dieso ogusuga melee omapoo ogusugileiso. Bei, goo hagee moodoolai Godee mapoo kitulugu moloso.

Esiga niba medee goolee, Yu odoonee niba olipi homo dobudu meli dee koodoloso see olipi homo dadabayo segei mapoo ogusuga masi ka moloso. Esino homo eyo goolee egeesee koo oluguli. Yu odoo ee tei olipi homo dadabayo segei o dee egeesi masi doso. Esiga Godeeye olipi homo dadabayo segei o dee peegoo kookoobugu ee see dieso olugulee mapoo ogusugilei yimapoo haga kodianee.
Isalael odoo see Godee mapoogilimado sibilei

Esiga tei telaga odoo emegei, goo mada magoo melee ayo nimapoo woola taka, egeeseega niba niso nediliyo si howelega dabalame. Egeesi ma kulodu goo mada melee ee hagoso, Godeeye koo mesili goo ee Isalael odoo abo mapoo teneeso. Esino goo ogoso kookaiyo osee malaime. Esino Yu odoonee Godeeye daga hoogoo hesia sabolo tobuloso, diayo Yesu mapoo tei toloso doga, hamamee koo mesili goo dimapoo egee molo ee pagalaiso.
Osoloso diayo tei too ee ogoloso, nei Isalael odoo susuga dia gie badeli pidileiso. Bei, Godeeyo to booka mapoo hogugu oso egeesee takooso,

content.text: “Gie badeli pidili odoo ee Sayon mi maga sibileiso.
Isalael odoo susuga oso goo tokenee tolone egee do goo ee yayo peegoo magalaiso.
Osoloso ayo dibolo to magoo ee dodolone,
dia goo tokenee hapoloso boobado bigileiso,” deeso.

content: Esiga epedee hamapoo Yu odoo aboso to tekepo mapoo gowoolone Godee mapoo ha tolone ka doso. Goo egeesi maga to tekepo ee Yu odoonee nimapoo simiso. Esino Yu odoo ee Godee tei eyo hesia odoo oso. Bei, Yu odooso tei Godee o odoo doloso dabalai goo ee Godeeye dia amawe dio daga debei mapoo to olo edidi magooso. Goo egeesi maga Yu odoo dimapoo Godeeye gooma ka moloso.
Bei, Godeeye tei o odoo hesialoso, yayo emegei di bi dimapoo wulayo teneega, yo o goo goolee see su koo widili.
Esiga Yu odoonee niyo daga Godee gowoolone debeiso. Esino see Yu odooso Godee gowoome, nei Godeeye see Yu odoonee niba sooloo dalaso.

Esiga niyo daga Godeeyo to gowoolone debei egeesee solone, epei see Yu odooso Godeeyo to gowoolone ka doso. Esino Godeeye niba sooloo dala egeesee solone, hamamee see Yu odoo nosee egeesee sooloo dalaiso.
Esiga Godeeye odoo susuga ee goo tokenee ma kulodu olo holoogooso, see hamamee dimapoo yayo sooloo deli goo ee eligilame.
Godeeyo hu dokodoo poude
O, tei takoo. Godeeyo goo goolee sabolo osoloso yayo gooleedoo ee diya toowa osoloso diya goodomou. Esiga edebeeyo yayo to magoo eyo bei sabolo, osoloso o goo ee gooleedalai koo tebili.
Bei, Godeeyo to booka mapoo hogugu oso egeesee takooso,

content.text: “Odoo agayo Godeeyo goo goolee eyo bei ka gooleedoowo?
Osoloso odoo agayo yo ka kokodo takasomo?
Osoloso Godeeye yimapoo nei tenelame,
daga malalo odoo agayo Godee mapoo bi ka teneeba? Haye, odoo mauwe.”

content: Bei, bi susuga ee Godeeye moodoo. Osoloso bi susuga yayo medee ka bamoloso. Osoloso bi susuga ee o. Esiga odoo susuga oso hedebe o hu dokodoo poudoolone kookaiyo osee dabalai tekepo. To hagee tei goo.

footnotes.text: To hageeyo bei ee egeesi moloso. Odoo hagee biaso Keliso mapoo tei tele poogoo maga, diba Godeeyo howo woola tekepo doloso koo doso. Goo egeesi maga dia howo neliga poga, diba Kelisowo to tekepo ee ogoloso gooleedalaime. Osoloso diba hegi goo ma kulodu dabalaiso.

To hageeyo bei ee egeesi moloso. Daga hoogoo Eibalaham, Aisek, osoloso Yekob hagee biaso Yu odoo dia wiligi odoo tebisaloso Godeeyo odoo doloso debeiso. Esiga dibada amawe dio onosee hamamee Godeeyo odoo doloso dabalaiso.
